fact: UNDP Sierra Leone's annual report says the Judiciary's mobile Justice App, launched in 2020 as a court case management system for the lower courts, has been used to dispose of 3,670 cases and automates case management, document management and scheduling.
UN Sierra Leone says the Judiciary and UNDP launched a case-management app in April 2017, piloted in Freetown and Makeni magistrate and High Courts and set to expand to Bo and Kenema.
